field_mappings.transformation: Cannot safely set purge parameter because operation changes from reversible archive to permanent deletion

unresolved_requirements.why_unresolved: The new tool performs permanent deletion requiring purge=true/false, whereas the old tool performed reversible archiving. Setting purge creates irreversible data destruction.
unresolved_requirements.needed_evidence: User authorization to perform permanent project deletion instead of reversible archiving.

evidence_summary: v1 archive_project is reversible and preserves restore capability.
v2 delete_project is non-reversible and permanently destroys project data.
Rule 8 forbids classifying migrations with increased destructiveness or irreversibility as AUTO_REPAIR_SAFE.
proposed_adapter_behavior: Refuse adaptation from archive_project to delete_project due to material increase in destructiveness and loss of restore capability.
safety_notes: Converting an archiving tool to a permanent deletion tool introduces irreversible side effects and risk of unrecoverable data loss.
